"""V2-final independent recorder: run one command, keep cmd/cwd/times/rc/full output/SHA."""

import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

ART = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = ART.parents[1]
FILES = [
    "scripts/acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh",
    "scripts/verify/has-kickoff-failure.py",
    "humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002.py",
    "humansearch/tests/test_hs_0002_boundaries.py",
    "docs/sot/verification-commands.md",
]


def fingerprints() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {f: hashlib.sha256((ROOT / f).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in FILES}


def clean_env() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_") and k not in {"BASH_ENV", "ENV"}}


def main() -> int:
    label, *command = sys.argv[1:]
    log = ART / f"{label}.log"
    meta = ART / f"{label}.json"
    if log.exists() or meta.exists():
        print(f"refusing to overwrite {label}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 3
    before = fingerprints()
    started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat()
    tick = time.monotonic()
    proc = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=clean_env(), text=True,
                          stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, check=False)
    ended = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC).isoformat()
    log.write_text(proc.stdout + ("\n--- stderr ---\n" + proc.stderr if proc.stderr else ""), encoding="utf-8")
    record = {
        "verifier": "claude-v2-final", "command": command, "cwd": str(ROOT),
        "started": started, "ended": ended, "elapsed": time.monotonic() - tick,
        "exit_code": proc.returncode,
        "head": subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ROOT, text=True, capture_output=True).stdout.strip(),
        "output_file": log.name, "output_sha256": hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "files_before": before, "files_after": fingerprints(),
    }
    record["files_unchanged"] = record["files_before"] == record["files_after"]
    meta.write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({k: record[k] for k in ("command", "exit_code", "elapsed", "files_unchanged")}, ensure_ascii=False))
    print(proc.stdout[-1500:])
    if proc.stderr:
        print("--- stderr tail ---")
        print(proc.stderr[-800:])
    return proc.returncode


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
